artifactUnderTest: clean-room extracted portable Legion Agent Plugins package bound to one signed Legion release

executionEnvironment.packageRoot: LEGION_PACKAGE_ROOT must be a clean extracted release artifact, never the source checkout
executionEnvironment.reportRoot: qualification-owned immutable evidence directory outside shipped Legion artifacts

commandContract.static: pnpm --dir $RIGHTKIT_AX_ROOT exec rightkit-ax validate --package $LEGION_PACKAGE_ROOT --profile static --format json --output $AX_REPORT_ROOT/static.json
commandContract.conformance: pnpm --dir $RIGHTKIT_AX_ROOT exec rightkit-ax validate --package $LEGION_PACKAGE_ROOT --profile conformance --format json --output $AX_REPORT_ROOT/conformance.json
commandContract.behavioral: pnpm --dir $RIGHTKIT_AX_ROOT exec rightkit-ax validate --package $LEGION_PACKAGE_ROOT --profile behavioral --format json --output $AX_REPORT_ROOT/behavioral.json
commandContract.adversarial: pnpm --dir $RIGHTKIT_AX_ROOT exec rightkit-ax validate --package $LEGION_PACKAGE_ROOT --profile adversarial --format sarif --output $AX_REPORT_ROOT/adversarial.sarif
commandContract.realClient: pnpm --dir $RIGHTKIT_AX_ROOT exec rightkit-ax validate --package $LEGION_PACKAGE_ROOT --profile real-client --clients $SUPPORTED_CLIENT_PROFILE --format json --output $AX_REPORT_ROOT/real-client.json

requiredEvidence: exact AX version and source commit
failurePolicy: Any failed required gate blocks release qualification. Missing optional Blueprint context is typed coverage degradation and does not abort unrelated AX gates.
prohibition: M0 does not install RightKit, add dependencies, create release machinery, run the commands, or modify Membrane.
